description: This file defines the 'LocaleChooser' object which provides methods for selecting the best matching locale from a list based on various criteria, including language, script, and country. It handles locale ranking and matching logic for localization purposes.

classes.name: LocaleChooser
classes.description: A singleton object providing locale matching and selection functions for localization.

methods.name: getBestLocale
methods.description: Determines the best matching locale from a map of locale keys based on a provided list of preferred locales.

methods.name: getInRankingOrder
methods.description: Recursively searches for a locale in ranking order based on script and country preferences.

methods.name: getFirstSameScript
methods.description: Finds a locale entry that shares the same script as the provided locale.

methods.name: getRankingTag
methods.description: Generates a ranking tag string for locale matching based on rank, script, and country.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Creates a Locale object based on language and country, considering SDK version differences.
